source: triage of the failing checks of the M-SM campaign (tests/unit/test_loop_v2_msm_*.py, m-sm/PLAN.md §1.4), curated by MS-VALIDATE from the campaign records (MS-REF's references in a scratch merge of work/v2-ms-ref, 2026-10-30) and the probes named per finding (workspace/tmp/ms-validate/probe-*); no tolerance widened beyond the user's ~10:20 ruling

findings.title: The native plan loader refuses EW plans: 'loop v2 plan: a (trace) step above the family rank'
findings.checks: every check of the row: the executor is not formed (both input paths)
findings.evidence: probe-rank (SC07, h h > h h QED): 12 of 87 families are written with rank 2 (schedules.build_trie: the largest summed segment q-degree of a ring) while plan_export._Exporter._step writes rank_in = the largest source storage and degree = the largest edge degree of a trie node (2 + 1 = 3), which rusticol's derive.rs / plan.rs refuse: a node joining rings of degree-0 and degree-1 vertices (W, Z, Goldstone and Higgs rings) over-runs every single ring. Candidate fix, tried in a scratch worktree (tmp/ms-validate/wt-fix, f1): the family's written rank bounds its steps, rank = max(trie.rank, max step rank_in + degree) in plan_export._Exporter.family (forward states and merged closures likewise): VH01 (Python inputs) 134/134 checks pass against MadLoop QP, SC07 (native inputs) every check but its vanishing single pole (ours 1e-33, MadLoop 1e-17; listed since)
findings.status: open: fixed on work/v2-ms-model 4f99d7fe (plan_export._trace_groups: a trace step whose source storage plus content degree exceeds the family rank splits by source storage), not yet integrated
findings.routed: MS-MODEL (4f99d7fe); the rows rerun when it integrates

findings.title: SC08 (t t~ > w+ w-) and ST03 (g b > t w-), G_mu with MB = ymb = 0 fixed, fail building the scalar evaluator: the untaken branch of a decided '0 if MB == 0 else ...' counterterm parameter keeps an infinite coefficient
findings.checks: every check: native inputs fail in native_trees._parameter_program, Python inputs in scalar_bindings.ScalarBindingPlan (scalar_frontend.evaluator)
findings.evidence: probe-f2 (SC08 on Python inputs, 2026-10-30): 2 of the 36 bound outputs fail alone, the t~ b W+ UV counterterm coupling c_UVtxbWp1EW at eps^-1 and eps^0. Its source holds the UFO's '0 if MB == 0 else <...>/MB...' counterterm parameters; scalar_frontend lowers an IfExp with both branches (symbolica::if(truth(if(equal(0,0),1,0)), 0, <else>)), so with MB fixed to 0 the untaken branch divides by zero (Symbolica: 'Created infinity by raising 0 to the power of -1') and the evaluator refuses the infinite coefficient. Rows without this coupling only log the warning. Candidate fix (owner's call): decide an IfExp whose lowered condition is a constant before lowering its branches (lower only the taken branch), in the scalar frontend that both input paths share
findings.routed: coordinator (scalar bindings / native parameter program owner)

findings.category: plan: Ward identity in the real-mass scheme
findings.title: The gluon (photon) Ward identity of the EW virtual fails where an external coloured (charged) particle has an absorptive self-energy at its mass
findings.checks: ward: TT03 and TV07 double-double 3e-4 / 6e-5 of the scale (c = 1 and i, every gluon), VV05 photon c = i 4e-4; rule 1 = MadLoop at the physical polarisations
findings.evidence: probe-ward (TT03, double-double, leg 1): residual 3.3e-4 (c = 1), 5.2e-5 (c = i) of the scale at the card (t -> b W open), 5e-30 and 4e-29 at MW = 180, MZ = 200 (stable top), the bare, R2 and UV parts 1e-2 each: the real on-shell counterterms (Re Sigma) leave the external top's absorptive part unrenormalised, the scheme's property, not an engine defect (the identity holds under CMS)
findings.status: resolved in the manifest: TT03 and TV07 check Ward at a stable top (ward_parameters MW = 180, MZ = 200); VV05 (external W) and ST03 (external top and W) defer it to the CMS rows (CM05, CM07, CM09)

findings.category: reference: MadLoop off the IR structure
findings.title: u u~ > mu- mu+ on the massive-muon G_mu copy: MadLoop's QED^6 single pole and finite part differ from ours by 0.05 and 2 Born
findings.checks: rule 1, QED^6 finite and single pole at every point (double pole and the QCD^2 QED^4 sector agree)
findings.evidence: probe-sc02 (double-double, points 0 and 2): the QED-only and the joint request give the same QED^6 values; ours = the engine's massive QED Catani operator + 3 (alpha/2pi) Born to seven digits (the copy's massless lepton field renormalisation, as on LL02, where ours = MadLoop's control), while MadLoop's single pole is the operator - 42 (alpha/2pi) Born. Per PLAN §4.1 Recola arbitrates a discrepancy above ~1e-5 (its own massive muon differs from the copy by the same field renormalisation)
findings.status: resolved by MS-REF's integrated re-run of uux_mummp_ew_mm (CutTools in the quadruple-precision stage, 047841b6): ours = MadLoop to 4.9e-9 in the QED^6 finite part (rule 1 at 1e-8 on SC02, the user's ~10:20 ruling), the poles to 1e-12 (c7)

findings.title: u d~ > e+ ve on the G_mu UFO's ckm restriction keeps a UV pole: its QED^6 single pole is the QED Catani operator - 0.0213 (alpha/2pi) Born (non-unitary O(lambda^3) Wolfenstein CKM), ours = MadLoop's
findings.checks: rule 4, QED^6 single pole at every point (rule 1 = MadLoop QP; the QCD^2 QED^4 sector meets its operator exactly)
findings.evidence: probe-sc03 (double-double, points 0 and 1): the offset is -0.021297 / -0.021183 (alpha/2pi) Born and independent of MB to 1e-6 (MB = ymb = 4.7, 2.35, 0.47); MS-REF's scheme record ew-gmu-ckm: the UFO's O(lambda^3) Wolfenstein CKM is not unitary, the remnant scales as lambda^4 (lamWS scan), MadLoop alike
findings.status: open (model property; rule 4 not formed on the row)
findings.routed: coordinator (PLAN §4.2 SC03: CKM rows need a CKM counterterm or a UV-pole exemption)
